## Checklist

- [ ] It builds: `bash mod/build.sh` (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] I tested it in the game (or say why I could not)
- [ ] New texts are written in Portuguese in the code and added to `OnlineLoc.cs` (English) and `OnlineLocKo.cs` (Korean), or I said they still need a translation
- [ ] If the protocol changed, both servers are updated (`server/node/server.mjs` and `server/cloudflare/src/index.ts`)
- [ ] No game files, personal data, keys or tokens in the change
